item.description:
Copas 1.1.6

Fixes the clipboard board sometimes not opening after Copas has been running for a long time.

  • Board Reliability: The board now checks whether its window is really on screen instead of trusting a remembered state, ignores stale app-switch events, and rebuilds its hidden window after sleep and wake, Space changes, or display changes.
  • Writing Tools: A stuck Writing Tools state can no longer keep the board from opening.
  • Diagnostics: The board now logs why it opens and closes, which makes any recurrence easier to track down.

Copas 1.1.4

Restores the Sync tab in Settings and enables full iCloud synchronization across Macs with an embedded Apple Developer ID provisioning profile.

  • Sync Settings Tab: Restored the dedicated Sync tab in Settings with the iCloud Sync toggle, real-time connection status, pending sync count, and manual "Sync Now" button.
  • iCloud CloudKit Integration: Fully entitled for private CloudKit container iCloud.com.sigitkusuma.copas via Apple Developer ID provisioning profile.
  • Security & Privacy: Stored securely via GitHub Actions secrets without exposing provisioning profiles in the public repository.

Copas 1.1.3

Enables iCloud Sync via embedded Developer ID provisioning profile.

  • iCloud Sync: The app now includes a provisioning profile that grants the com.apple.developer.icloud-container-identifiers entitlement, allowing CloudKit to initialize without requiring a Mac App Store distribution.
  • Stability: No change to local clipboard history, database, or existing features. The sync engine remains gated behind the Sync toggle in Settings.
